verdict: MONOTONICITY — FAILING. Walking outward from the inlet, u1d RISES by up to +4.290e-02 (relative to its span) on some edge. With a single source, concentration cannot increase as you move away from it.

MASS CONSERVATION — OK. Delivery 2.643336e-03 vs absorption 2.643340e-03, relative imbalance 1.59e-06. These are computed by completely different routes (the discrete coupling operators C and G vs a volume integral), so agreement to this level is strong evidence the coupling is correct.
COUPLING OPERATOR — OK. max|C@1 - 1| = 4.44e-16. The circle-average reproduces constants exactly, so it is mass-preserving by construction.

RESOLUTION — the 3D cells are up to 129x larger than the thinnest vessel (h=0.0866). The line source is smeared over a cell, so the perivascular gradient is unresolved and u3d overshoots max(u1d) by +1.37e-02. This is a genuine modelling limitation, not a bug: resolving it needs local refinement around the centerlines.
